name: ado-grok
description: Connect Grok Bot to Azure DevOps via Microsoft's official local MCP (@azure-devops/mcp). Paste a raw PAT into Grok Bot — encoding runs on the bot computer. No user laptop or Azure CLI required.

ADO_ORG.title: Azure DevOps organization
ADO_ORG.description: Organization name only (e.g. myorg), not the full URL.

ADO_PAT.title: Azure DevOps Personal Access Token
ADO_PAT.description: Paste your raw Azure DevOps PAT here (Grok Bot stores it securely). Do not base64-encode it — the plugin encodes on the bot computer. Typical scopes: Work Items, Code, Build (read or read/write as needed).
